<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 50!
factorial_50 = math.factorial(50)
print(f"50! = {factorial_50}")

# Convert to string and sum the digits
digits_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in str(factorial_50))
print(f"\nSum of decimal digits: {digits_sum}")

# Show the breakdown
digits_str = str(factorial_50)
print(f"\nNumber of digits: {len(digits_str)}")
print(f"Digits: {digits_str}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
